name: matchlens
description: Matchlens: multi-agent live match intelligence (FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend)

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.dev:backend:offline: cd backend && MATCHLENS_LLM=offline uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.dev:backend:demo: cd backend && MATCHLENS_LLM=offline MATCHLENS_CASSETTE=demo/hero-match.json uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.dev:backend:db: cd backend && MATCHLENS_LLM=offline MATCHLENS_CASSETTE=demo/hero-match.json MATCHLENS_COSMOS_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8081 uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.db:next10: docker start matchlens-next10-cosmos 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name matchlens-next10-cosmos --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8091:8091 -p 127.0.0.1:8092:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:1244:1244 -v "$PWD/backend/data/local/cosmos-next10:/data" mcr.microsoft.com/cosmosdb/linux/azure-cosmos-emulator:vnext-latest --port 8091 --explorer-port 1244
scripts.next10:init: cd backend && uv run python -m matchlens.store.next10 init
scripts.next10:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m matchlens.store.next10 seed
scripts.shadow:fit: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.predict.shadow fit
scripts.shadow:fixtures: cd backend && MATCHLENS_FOTMOB=1 uv run python -m matchlens.predict.shadow fixtures
scripts.shadow:watch: cd backend && MATCHLENS_FOTMOB=1 uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.predict.shadow watch
scripts.shadow:score: cd backend && MATCHLENS_FOTMOB=1 uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.predict.shadow score
scripts.test:db: cd backend && MATCHLENS_COSMOS_TEST_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8081 uv run pytest -q tests/test_store.py
scripts.test:next10: cd backend && MATCHLENS_NEXT10_TEST_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8091 uv run pytest -q tests/test_next10_store.py tests/test_shadow.py
scripts.export:dataset: cd backend && uv run python -m matchlens.dataset.export --out ../dataset --schemas ../docs/schema
scripts.record:demo: cd backend && uv run python -m matchlens.agents.record --out demo/hero-match.json
scripts.data:fetch: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata fetch
scripts.data:build: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata build
scripts.data:curate: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata curate
scripts.data:reason: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata reason
scripts.data:playbooks: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata playbooks
scripts.data:export: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata export
scripts.data:status: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.leaguedata status
scripts.tacticsml:train: cd backend && uv run --group tactics-ml python -m matchlens.tacticsml.train fit
scripts.tacticsml:export: cd backend && uv run --group tactics-ml python -m matchlens.tacticsml.train export
scripts.tacticsml:eval: cd backend && uv run --group tactics-ml python -m matchlens.tacticsml.train evaluate
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.data:season: cd backend && uv run --group leaguedata python -m matchlens.dataset.season
scripts.db:seed:season: cd backend && uv run python -m matchlens.store.seed
